defs.def: to put forward an idea or a plan for other people to think about 建议；提议

ex.s: Which of the following may Commane suggest based on their study?
ex.t: 基于他们的研究，Commane可能会提出以下哪项建议？

ex.s: Daniel and Rachel suggested that Emily continue her journey by train.
ex.t: Daniel和Rachel建议Emily乘火车继续旅程。

ex.s: What does Wipke suggest regarding energy transition?
ex.t: 关于能源转型，Wipke建议了什么？

ex.s: My wife suggested I get in touch with my brother, but I resisted, thinking he should call first.
ex.t: 我妻子建议我和我弟弟取得联系，但我抗拒，觉得应该他先打电话。

ex.s: What does the author suggest visitors do in Mevagissey?
ex.t: 作者建议游客在 Mevagissey 做什么？

ex.s: He suggested I think about the difference between endings that I wanted for the characters and endings that were right for the characters, endings that satisfied the story even if they didn’t have a traditionally positive outcome.
ex.t: 他建议我思考：我想要的结局和适合角色的结局之间的区别——那些让故事圆满的结局，即便不是传统意义上的美满结局。

ex.s: Given the degree of doubt, Mr Stienwand suggests, “it would be wise to stop cloud seeding.” In practice, doubt has had the opposite effect.
ex.t: 鉴于怀疑的程度，斯坦万德先生建议：“停止人工降雨是明智的。”但在实践中，怀疑产生了相反的效果。

ex.s: What does the author suggest readers do?
ex.t: 作者建议读者怎么做？

ex.s: Jessica Pink, an undergraduate student, suggests taking online courses with a friend, so you can motivate each other to stay on track.
ex.t: 本科生Jessica Pink建议与朋友一起参加在线课程，这样你们就可以激励彼此保持正轨。

ex.s: What does the author suggest readers do with the practices offered in part two?
ex.t: 作者建议读者如何使用第二部分提供的实践练习？

ex.s: What does the woman suggest they do next?
ex.t: 这位女士建议他们接下来做什么？

ex.s: What does Ethan suggest Becky do regarding her mother?
ex.t: 关于她的母亲，伊桑建议贝基怎么做？

ex.s: How often does the speaker suggest people do hard workouts?
ex.t: 演讲者建议人们多久做一次高强度锻炼？

ex.s: What do the dogs’ different responses in “unwilling” and “unable” scenarios suggest?
ex.t: 狗在“不愿”和“不能”两种情境下不同的反应说明了什么？

ex.s: What does Curtin suggest people do?
ex.t: Curtin建议人们做什么？

ex.s: What does Dr Nieca Goldberg suggest?
ex.t: Nieca Goldberg博士建议什么？

ex.s: Why does the man suggest going to the park?
ex.t: 这位男士为什么建议去公园？

ex.s: What does the man suggest the woman do?
ex.t: 说话者之间是什么关系？

ex.s: But something about quantum computing makes it especially prone to hype, Johnson suggests, perhaps because “‘quantum’ stands for something cool you shouldn’t be able to understand.” And that brings me back to Taylor, who suggested that I read his book Q for Quantum.
ex.t: 但量子计算的某些特点使其特别容易受到炒作的影响，Johnson暗示道，也许是因为"'量子'代表着你本不该理解的酷东西。"这让我回到了Taylor身边，他建议我读他的书《Q for Quantum》。

ex.s: When a plane is leaving in 15 minutes and the door is closing, what else can we suggest but: “Run!
ex.t: 当一架飞机还有15分钟就要起飞、舱门即将关闭时，除了建议"快跑！

ex.s: Where does the woman suggest David go for his next holiday?
ex.t: 女士建议大卫下次假期去哪里？

ex.s: Where does the woman suggest David go for his next holiday?
ex.t: 女士建议大卫下次假期去哪里？

ex.s: William Hastie once suggested that history informs us of past mistakes                   we can learn without repeating them.
ex.t: 威廉·哈斯蒂曾经建议历史告诉我们过去的错误                   我们可以从中学习而不必重蹈覆辙。

ex.s: What does the woman seem to suggest Bill do?
ex.t: 那个女人建议比尔做什么？

ex.t: 那个女人建议比尔做什么？

ex.t: 谁建议Norman为儿童读物画画？

ex.s: What does the author suggest readers do while reading the plays?
ex.t: 作者建议读者阅读剧本时做什么？

ex.s: The camp manager suggested I use pepper spray.
ex.t: 营地管理员建议我使用胡椒喷雾。

ex.s: A GI could, its advocates say, work for us around the clock, and drawing on all available data, could suggest solutions to many problems.
ex.t: 其支持者说，AGI可以日夜不停地为我们工作，并借助一切可用数据，为许多问题提出解决方案。

ex.s: To suggest a way of pursuing excellence in our lifelong career．
ex.t: D．为我们终身职业追求卓越提出一种方法。

ex.s: What does the text suggest people do about old electronic devices?
ex.t: 文章建议人们如何处理旧电子设备？

ex.s: What does the coffee-shop study suggest about small talk?
ex.t: 咖啡店的研究关于闲聊说明了什么？

ex.s: Parents are often surprised when teachers suggest their children read magazines.
ex.t: 杂志文章可以为不愿阅读的读者提供生动轻快的写作风格，能够激励他们多读书。

ex.s: Last week some city officials suggested the city might be interested in turning the old theater into a museum and public meeting place.
ex.t: 上周，一些市政官员表示，该市可能有兴趣把这座老剧院改造成博物馆和公共集会场所。

ex.s: What does the underlined sentence in paragraph 3 suggest?
ex.t: 第3段中的下划线句意味着什么？

ex.s: Why does Jim suggest Mary buy the book?
ex.t: 为什么吉姆建议玛丽买这本书？

ex.s: He might not have done this particularly well,     46       the teacher told Gabriel that he had a good     47       and suggested that Gabriel go into the music store-room to see if any of the instruments there     48       him.
ex.t: 他可能做得不是特别好，____46____老师告诉Gabriel他有很好的____47____，并建议Gabriel去音乐储藏室看看那里有没有什么乐器____48____他。

ex.s: Indeed official figures suggest the country has shrunk by 5% since 1993 and people in Russia live a shorter life now than those in 1961.
ex.t: 事实上，官方数据显示，该国自1993年以来已缩减了5%，俄罗斯人的寿命现在比1961年时更短。

ex.s: Part one concludes by introducing my suggested method for adopting this philosophy: the digital declutter.
ex.t: 第一部分最后介绍了我建议的践行这一理念的方法：数字清理。

ex.s: We would like to suggest...
ex.t: 我们建议...

ex.s: In order to..., we suggest...
ex.t: 为了... 我们建议...

ex.s: As the name suggests, it is located on the west of the continent, and takes up about one-third of the continent’s landmass.
ex.t: 顾名思义，它位于大陆的西部，约占大陆面积的三分之一。

ex.s: If possible, suggest an alternative - How about next week?
ex.t: 如果可能，建议替代方案-下周怎么样？

ex.s: The researchers are so impressed that they suggest the elephant’s suction technique could help improve robotics technology.
ex.t: 研究人员印象如此深刻，以至于他们建议大象的吸力技术可能有助于改进机器人技术。

defs.def: to tell sb about a suitable person, thing, method, etc. for a particular job or purpose 推荐；举荐
to put an idea into sb's mind; to make sb think that sth is true 使想到；使认为；表明

ex.s: What does the last paragraph suggest?
ex.t: 最后一段表明了什么？

ex.s: Does the name of the college you attend really matter？Research on the question   7  （suggest）that，for most students，it doesn't.
ex.t: 你所上的大学的名字真的重要吗？对这个问题的研究   7  （suggest）表明，对大多数学生来说，并不重要。

ex.s: In addition, the team set up a separate experiment that suggested that the baby birds that most closely imitated their mom’s voice were rewarded with the most food.
ex.t: 此外，研究团队还设立了一个独立的实验，表明那些模仿母亲声音最像的幼鸟得到了最多的食物。

ex.s: However, research suggests that if we practiced patience, we’d be a whole lot better off.
ex.t: 然而，研究表明，如果我们练习耐心，我们的境况会好得多。

ex.s: And the appearance of new-born giants suggests that newcomers can make waves, too.
ex.t: 新巨头的出现表明新来者也能掀起波澜。

ex.s: Importantly, however, the beauty group did not report feeling any happier than the control group, suggesting that it was the engagement with beauty that influenced abstract thinking, rather than any overall positivity from the experience.
ex.t: 然而重要的是，美感组并没有报告比对照组更快乐，这表明影响抽象思维的是与美的接触，而不是这次经历带来的整体积极情绪。

ex.s: This suggests that moments of moral effort may be part of a life that, taken as a whole, feels more satisfying.
ex.t: 这表明，道德努力的时刻或许正是这样一种生活的一部分：整体来看，它让人感到更满足。

ex.s: Fortunately, analyses suggest that renewables are up to the task.
ex.t: 幸运的是，分析表明可再生能源能够胜任这一任务。

ex.s: The new study suggests boiling tap water could be a tool to limit intake.
ex.t: 这项新研究表明，煮沸自来水可能是一个限制摄入的工具。

ex.s: New evidence suggests, however, that rainfall — particularly increasing autumn rain — is now contributing significantly to permafrost loss.
ex.t: 然而，新的证据表明，降雨——尤其是日益增多的秋雨——如今正在显著加剧永久冻土的消融。

ex.s: Since the effects were small, this may suggest that our creative thinking does not differ that much in response to total silence and 85 decibels of background noise.
ex.t: 由于影响很小，这可能表明我们的创造性思维在完全安静和85分贝背景噪音下的反应并没有太大不同。

ex.s: But since the results at 70 decibels were significant, the study also suggests that the right level of background noise—not too loud and not total silence—may actually improve one’s creative thinking ability.
ex.t: 但由于70分贝下的结果具有显著性，该研究也表明，适当的背景噪音水平——不太吵也不完全无声——实际上可能提升一个人的创造性思维能力。

ex.s: Recent research suggests that if an argument gets resolved，the emotional response tied to it is significantly reduced or almost completely erased．Thus，it may be worth bringing up issues with your friends， family members，or classmates rather than holding them back．
ex.t: 最近的研究表明，如果一场争论得到解决，与之相关的情绪反应会显著减少，或几乎完全消除。因此，与其压抑，不如与朋友、家人或同学把问题提出来，可能最终会有更好的结果。

ex.s: Official reports suggest that the number of households with three generations living together had risen from 325,000 in 2002 to 419,000 in 2013.
ex.t: 官方报告显示，三代同堂的家庭数量从2002年的325,000户增加到2013年的419,000户。

ex.s: Yet the researchers suggest that single parents still may play a role in teaching the benefits of persistence, which is an avenue of future research.
ex.t: 然而，研究人员指出，单亲父母仍可能在教导坚持的好处方面发挥作用，这是未来研究的一个方向。

ex.s: Challenging work that requires lots of analytical thinking, planning and other managerial skills might help your brain stay sharp as you age, a study published Wednesday in the journal Neurology suggests.
ex.t: 周三发表在《神经学》期刊上的一项研究表明，需要大量分析思考、规划和其他管理技能的富有挑战性的工作，可能有助于你的大脑随着年龄增长保持敏锐。

ex.s: A piece of stone   8  (find) on a Dutch beach suggests that our extinct human relatives, known as Neanderthals,
ex.t: 在荷兰海滩上___8___（find）的一块石头表明，我们已灭绝的人类近亲——尼安德特人，

ex.s: So far there is no effective way to get rid of it, but a new study suggests an answer may lie in the stomachs of some hungry worms.
ex.t: 到目前为止，还没有有效的方法来摆脱它，但一项新研究表明答案可能在于某些饥饿蠕虫的胃里。

ex.s: The researchers call the effect “enclothed cognition,” suggesting that all manner of different clothes probably affect our cognition in many different ways.
ex.t: 研究人员称之为“着装认知”效应，认为各种各样不同的衣服可能以许多不同的方式影响我们的认知。

ex.s: An evolutionary inference can then be drawn. ＂As a parent, do you invest in quality children, or do you invest in children that are in need?＂ Kleindorfer asks. ＂Our results suggest that they might be going for quality.＂
ex.t: 由此可以做出一个进化上的推断。“作为父母，你是投资在优质的孩子身上，还是投资在需要帮助的孩子身上？”克莱因多弗问道。“我们的结果表明，它们可能是在追求质量。”

ex.s: Their research also suggests how we may build lasting memories over time even though the synapses become thinner.
ex.t: 他们的研究也揭示了我们如何能在突触变细的情况下随着时间建立持久的记忆。

ex.s: "There is a lot of really interesting evidence which seems to be suggesting that if children are inspired up to the age of seven, then being outdoors will be a habit for life." His own children have got into the habit of playing outside now: "We just send them out into the garden and tell them not to come back in for a while."
ex.t: “有大量非常有趣的证据似乎表明，如果孩子在七岁前受到启发，那么待在户外将成为一生的习惯。”他自己的孩子现在也养成了在外面玩的习惯：“我们只是把他们赶到花园里，告诉他们一会儿别回来。”

ex.s: "Instead, our results suggest that the successful dogs realized that a smiling mouth means the same thing as smiling eyes, and the same rule applies to an angry mouth having the same meaning as angry eyes.”
ex.t: “相反，我们的结果表明，成功的狗意识到微笑的嘴和微笑的眼睛表达的是同一意思，同样的规则也适用于生气的嘴和生气的眼睛含义相同。”

ex.s: Getting the “side-eye” look from your dog can make it seem like they are making a judgement about you, and some new studies suggest they really could be.
ex.t: 从你的狗那里得到“斜眼”一瞥，会让它们看起来像是在对你做出评判，一些新研究表明它们可能确实如此。

defs.def: to state sth indirectly 暗示；言下之意是说

ex.s: A topic sentence is a sentence that states or suggests the main idea or topic of a paragraph.
ex.t: 主题句是陈述或暗示段落主旨或主题的句子。

ex.s: But even this dismissal suggests something：perhaps, just like life itself throughout the universe, the rise of ALife will prove unavoidable.
ex.t: 但即使是这种否定也暗示着某种东西：也许就像宇宙中的生命本身一样，ALife的兴起将是不可避免的。

ex.s: However, the stone tool made by Neanderthals suggests otherwise.
ex.t: 上周末在我们全家在韦尔镇聚会后，我对人性的信任从未如此之高。
